answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fakes. Each agent occupies one vertex and locks 200 POA for one slot; the deposit burns if it clones itself or stays silent for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA destroyed, while an epoch pays 4,000 POA, so a sybil fleet loses money on every run. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, growing like a juniper, while a fake flashes past like a comet, leaving a burned deposit.
